_comment: Settings of the AugureAI route of claude-switch.ps1 (Issue #112): read by augure_models.py and litellm-autostart.ps1. Every value is {value, provenance} (R4); a missing key is an error that names it (R3). No key VALUE is ever stored here, only the NAME of the variable that holds it.

mcp_url.provenance: measured 2026-11-27: initialize and tools/list answered 200 with bearer auth

mcp_protocol_version.provenance: measured 2026-11-27: the server echoed this protocolVersion in its initialize result

mcp_list_tool.provenance: measured 2026-11-27: tools/list names it, free, returns structuredContent.models[].id

api_base.provenance: https://augureai.ca/fr/documentation/api, read 2026-11-27: SDK base URL; GET /models answered 200 the same day

proxy_host.provenance: spec 2026-11-27: loopback only, any other value is refused

proxy_port.provenance: LiteLLM's documented default port, found free on 2026-11-27 (no listener); confirmed by the plan 1 spike

liveness_path.provenance: measured 2026-11-27 against litellm 1.111.0: answered 200 "I'm alive!" about 8 to 18 s after start

http_timeout_s.provenance: proposal of the session 2026-11-27 for one MCP or liveness request; the 2026-11-27 probes answered in under 2 s

proxy_start_timeout_s.provenance: proposal of the session 2026-11-27: how long the launcher waits for the liveness route after starting the proxy

master_key_env.provenance: spec 2026-11-27: User-scope variable created add-only by litellm-autostart.ps1 -Install

config_path.provenance: spec 2026-11-27: rendered, never committed, must resolve inside ~/.claude (R24)

log_path.provenance: spec 2026-11-27, same folder as the rendered config

log_max_bytes.provenance: proposal of the session 2026-11-27: 5 MiB, rotated once, like vault-daemon-autostart.ps1

litellm_provider.provenance: measured 2026-11-27 with litellm 1.111.0: the 'openai' provider sent /v1/messages through the OpenAI Responses API and failed on Augure's event stream (JSONDecodeError, HTTP 500); 'hosted_vllm' uses chat/completions and returned 200, streaming and tool_use included
